title: PM Modi slams Oppn, says India must unite against forces dividing nation
description:
Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Saturday attacked the Opposition, saying it had turned into "Avrodh Paksh" (obstructive force) rather than "Virodh Paksh" (opposing group), underscoring that the country needs to stay united.
He was addressing a gathering at the Parade Ground in Gujarat's Ekta Nagar on the occasion of Rashtriya Ekta Diwas, marking the 151st birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.
"It is our misfortune that the Opposition has turned into Avrodh Paksh," Modi said.
In a veiled reference to Congress leader Rahul Gandhi's foreign trips, Modi asked, "Who is secretly meeting whom in foreign countries? Forces opposed to India are extending their support to whom? Who is speaking the language of India's enemies?"
He said the nation needs to stand united against such forces and alleged that the Opposition wants to divide the people of the country.
"Social media is being used as a weapon, rumours are being spread, and India's image is being tarnished," he said.
